optimizedDescription.value: ConfigWriter port defines project initialization and plugin declaration mutation without application-layer filesystem coupling.

optimizedContext.value:
# ConfigWriter

## Rules
- TypeScript interface, not abstract class: `initProject`, `addPlugin`, `removePlugin`, `listPlugins`. Port lives application/ports.
- `initProject(InitProjectOptions): Promise<InitProjectResult>`. Options: absolute projectRoot, schemaRef, workspaceId, relative specsPath, optional force. Result: configPath, schemaRef, readonly workspaces, project-relative metadataCachePath.
- Initialize specd.yaml with schema/default workspace and omit storage; create specs plus `.specd/{changes,drafts,discarded,archive}`; ensure metadata cache. For default fs metadata only, append rooted `/.specd/metadata/` to root .gitignore. Create `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore` with normative tmp-ignore contents. Add `specd.local.yaml` and `specd.local.*.yaml` ignores idempotently.
- Existing specd.yaml without force throws `AlreadyInitialisedError`; force overwrites.
- `addPlugin(configPath,type,name,config?)` adds unique `{name,config?}` under plugins[type]; `removePlugin` removes named entry; both return Promise<void>. Optional config remains absent unless supplied/required.
- Delivery obtains wired port via `createConfigWriter()` from `@specd/core`; never imports `FsConfigWriter`. Prefer existing `SpecdConfig` snapshot over `listPlugins` for declaration reads.

## Constraints
- Port has no node:fs/yaml/I/O dependency. `AlreadyInitialisedError` application-layer.
- Plugin shape: `{ agents: Array<{name, config?}> }`.
